headline: Far fewer United flights are in the air than usual right now.

items.text: The 174 United flights in the air are 73% fewer than usual for this time of day: over the past 7 days, the median at this hour was 651.

A ground delay program holds flights into San Francisco (SFO) until 11:59 PM PT because of wind, with delays averaging 138 minutes and up to 690 minutes. San Francisco also has 3 confirmed cancellations among its 323 departures today.
Los Angeles (LAX) is the lowest of the hubs reporting so far today, with 73% of departures leaving within 30 minutes of schedule (52 departed).

The FAA has a ground stop for flights into Toronto (YYZ) until 6:15 PM ET, and ground delay programs for flights into Boston (BOS) until 9:59 PM ET and New York LaGuardia (LGA) until 10:59 PM ET. A ground stop or ground delay program is possible for flights into Newark (EWR) until 10:00 PM ET; it is not in effect.

traveler_note.text: If you are flying to San Francisco, check your flight status before leaving for the airport, and do the same before flying to Toronto, Boston or New York LaGuardia.
